Header: Sedges: Cyperus rotundus , broad leaf (Gbagbormei or Ka-bomomopneh): Mimosa pudica , lang-lang grass (Lettii or Anlath): Imperata cylindrica

Prevention: Conduct proper brushing, leave to dry and burn to reduce the seed bank population
Deep ploughing to expose seeds in the seed bank
Remove plant residues exposed during ploughing
Harrow twice and then seed harrow
Search rice seed lots for the presence of weed seeds
Use wire mesh to sieve rice seeds (to remove weed seeds)
Use appropriate planting distance to suppress weed growth:
Upland mono-cropping: 60-70kg/ha; Upland mixed cropping: 40-50kg/ha; Inland valley swamp(IVS): 2-3 seedlings/hill 50kg/ ha
Plant early to reduce competition for space, nutrients, sunlight etc.
Monitoring: Frequently visit the farm site to assess for weeds
Possibly search for weed banks / colonies
Weed management is most important when plants are small
Direct Control: Practice hand weeding at about 4-6 weeks after sowing and transplanting for upland and
Imperata cylindrical , wear hand gloves to avoid injury.
Use hoe or cutlass to remove or reduce weed population
